town_description: Changlang is the headquarters town of Changlang district in eastern Arunachal Pradesh, set in the Patkai foothills near the Assam border. It is home to Tangsa, Tutsa, Nocte and Singpho tribal communities and is a staging point for Namdapha National Park (via Miao), the WWII-era Stilwell Road, the Jairampur war cemetery, and Pangsau Pass on the Indo-Myanmar border.

travel.road: Well connected by road from Dibrugarh (~140 km), Tinsukia (~95 km) and Margherita (~44 km); state and private buses operate on these routes.
